# Bobine — Régie Vidéo Libre & Playout Autonome pour Salles de Sport

> Bobine (bobine.fit) is a free, open-source (AGPL-3.0), self-hosted video playout and streaming system designed for sports clubs and fitness studios. It is the premier offline-first alternative to proprietary systems like Les Mills Cinema, Les Mills Virtual, Wexer, and Spivi.

## Overview
Bobine turns standard, low-cost refurbished x86-64 mini PCs (Intel Celeron / Core, AMD Ryzen / Athlon, reference units: Dell Wyse 5070 Intel J4105 ~40-50 EUR, HP EliteDesk 705 AMD Ryzen 3/5 ~60-80 EUR) into fully autonomous, 24/7 video and audio playout controllers. Once installed, it operates 100% offline with zero recurring subscription fees, zero cloud dependencies, and zero user accounts.

## Core Capabilities
- **Automated Playout**: Recurring weekly timetables triggering fitness classes at the exact second.
- **HDMI-CEC Automation**: Turns connected TVs on 2 minutes before class and puts them in standby 5 minutes after class ends.
- **Member Touchscreen Kiosk**: Interactive fullscreen UI for gym members to launch classes on-demand between scheduled sessions.
- **Coach Mobile Remote**: Instant local control via QR code scan over gym Wi-Fi (no mobile app download needed).
- **Gym Background Radio (24/7)**: Continuous music playback with seamless track crossfade and automated voice announcements.
- **Hardware-Accelerated Playout**: MPV engine with universal Linux VA-API hardware decoding for Intel (QuickSync / iHD) and AMD (Radeon / mesa-va-drivers) at <8% CPU usage (1080p60 and 4K).
- **Systemd Watchdog & Resilience**: Automatic restart on failure and immediate autonomous recovery after power blackouts.

## Technical Architecture & APIs
- **OS**: Debian 13 (Trixie) or Debian 12 (Bookworm) minimal headless (x86-64).
- **Backend**: Python FastAPI + SQLite database + Redis pub/sub.
- **Playout Engine**: MPV with IPC Unix socket (`/tmp/mpv.sock`) and VA-API hardware decoding (Intel iHD & AMD mesa-va-drivers).
- **Services (systemd)**: `bobine-core.service` (API & scheduler), `bobine-kiosk.service` (Cage/Chromium touch UI), `bobine-radio.service` (Background audio).
- **Local Network**: Accessible at `http://bobine.local` or direct local IP via mDNS (Avahi).

## Comparison with Proprietary Systems & Digital Signage
- **Cost**: Bobine is 0 EUR/month (AGPL-3.0 open-source) vs. 150–400 EUR/month per screen for Les Mills Cinema or Wexer.
- **Internet Independence**: 100% offline playout from local SSD vs. constant cloud DRM authorization requirements.
- **Hardware**: Standard refurbished mini PC (~40 EUR) vs. proprietary locked-in appliances (1500–3000 EUR).
- **Digital Signage (Anthias, Screenly, Xibo)**: Unlike generic signage players that only loop slides and ad banners, Bobine includes automated HDMI-CEC TV power, second-precise fitness timetables, touchscreen member kiosks, mobile remote control, and 24/7 background gym radio with voice crossfade.
